judgment.notes: At S002, Z=Space, μ=dx, κ=ℝ, v=basis(j), f=V(·,t0)_k and g=Psp(j,·,t0)_k have exactly the types required by M003 and its displayed signature. N001 and BG001 give both functions differentiable everywhere, hence on the opposite topological supports. N001 identifies Df(v)=W(j)_k and Dg(v)=Ssp(j)_k. Since t0>0 implies t0/2<t0<3t0/2, N002 supplies integrability separately for W(j)_k Psp(j)_k, V_k Ssp(j)_k and V_k Psp(j)_k. Thus all three integrability and both differentiability hypotheses hold. S001 establishes F001 from positive-time smoothness and the actual derivative equalities in N001, using N002 at r=t0. Applying M003 gives ∫V_k Ssp(j)_k=−∫W(j)_k Psp(j)_k for every k. S003 sums these identities using integrable finite-sum linearity, expands D003, commutes real multiplication and rearranges the sign to give exactly ∫dot(Psp(j),W(j))=−∫dot(V,Ssp(j)). N002 supplies both dot-product integrabilities and every exported scalar-product integrability; F001 also identifies the directional-derivative products.
